parent.status: performance-positive but system-rejected because target-only generation diverged; v24 does not alter or supersede that decision

current_pipeline: Quantize four F32 rows into native block_q8_Kx4.
Traverse the complete native Q8_K buffer a second time and copy scales, codes, and sums into a row-major Q8_K workspace.
Synchronize again at the ordinary work-chunk barrier, then execute the four-accumulator Q4_K kernel.
diagnosis.redundancy: The native quantizer already holds every row's scale and every 32-byte group of quant codes in registers. The row-major bytes can be emitted from those same registers; the post-pass reads and its dedicated barrier are not algebraically necessary.
diagnosis.performance_anchor: The arithmetic-changing direct-row producer in v5 reached a 1.216x four-row graph speedup, while the exact v21 bridge reached 1.137x. This experiment tests whether producer fusion recovers a material part of that gap without changing a single Q8 code, scale, sum, or downstream accumulation.

hypothesis: An AVX2 dual-layout Q8_K producer that writes native block_q8_Kx4 and four ordinary block_q8_K rows directly from the same quantization registers will remove the complete deinterleave traversal and one threadpool barrier, preserve both output layouts byte-for-byte relative to v21, and improve the real Qwen3.8-27B exact-four-row graph by at least five percent over v21.

allowed: Add one exact AVX2 dual-output variant of ggml_quantize_mat_q8_K_4x8.
For exact-four-row Q4_K 8x8 operations only, call the dual-output producer instead of native production followed by ggml_repack_q8_K_4x8_to_q8_K_rows.
Remove the now-redundant dedicated post-quantization barrier; retain the existing work-chunk barrier before any consumer reads the workspace.
forbidden: No quantization scale, rounding instruction, saturation, Q8 code, bsum, Q4 weight decode, accumulation order, model, tokenizer, sampler, cache, or draft model may change.
No path outside exact-four-row Q4_K 8x8 matrix multiplication may change.
No high-precision activation or weight materialization may be introduced.
The v21 and v22 decisions remain immutable regardless of this result.

layout_contract.native_output: byte-identical to ggml_quantize_mat_q8_K_4x8 for the same F32 input
layout_contract.row_major_output: byte-identical to applying ggml_repack_q8_K_4x8_to_q8_K_rows to that native output
layout_contract.row_major_codes: rows[row * nb + block].qs[group8 * 8 + lane] = native[block].qs[group8 * 32 + row * 8 + lane]
layout_contract.workspace_bytes: unchanged from v21: one native and one row-major Q8_K image

required_special_cases: repeated absolute maxima with opposite signs
non-finite inputs handled identically to the parent producer

stop_rules: Reject before timing if either output layout differs by one bit, any source F32 byte changes, or any backend case fails.
Reject the speed hypothesis if either the microbenchmark or paired real-model graph threshold fails; do not retune thresholds after observation.
Run the frozen quick capability suite after any correct system execution, even if the MTP3 speed gate rejects.
Reject if v24 changes any v21 target token, committed MTP3 token, draft acceptance count, or quick-eval item output.
Record infrastructure-invalid separately from a scientific zero or rejection.
promotion_boundary: A pass promotes a byte-exact producer optimization for the Qwen3.8-27B four-row speculative-verification path on four Milan cores. It does not rehabilitate v21's rejected target-only parity result, establish the 2.75 tok/s conventional-decode breakthrough gate, validate the v23 calibrated model composition, prove final-node or energy scaling, approach 100 tok/s, or establish scientific novelty.
